description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Glasspool Mimic onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
